facts.fact: Alexander 在整个冬天大部分时间外出远行，从不向她解释去向与缘由。
facts.anchor: He was gone for most of that winter, though he never fully explained to me where he went or what he was doing.

facts.fact: 他把母亲传下的格子呢围巾围在她颈上，她心里害怕，等着它活过来勒死自己——对成为 S— 一员的恐惧。
facts.anchor: it sat around my throat limply as I waited for it to come to life and strangle me

facts.fact: Mrs White 得知她喜爱刺绣后，为她购置了一整套刺绣工具与彩线。
facts.anchor: When Mrs White learned of my love of embroidery, long abandoned to other shores, she procured a full kit

facts.fact: Eliza 偷偷递给她自家苹果做的、刚出炉的苹果塔，她坐在台阶上边吃边看日出。
facts.anchor: The sweet apple tarts made from our own preserved apples, fresh from the oven, handed over secretly by Eliza

facts.fact: Eliza 端上浇着焦糖酱的 molotof 布丁，她尝到家乡的味道，几乎在餐桌前落泪。
facts.anchor: It tasted like home, and I nearly wept at the dinner table

facts.fact: 外出归来沉沦一周后，Alexander 刮净胡子、穿着笔挺的招牌西装，手持红玫瑰等在门外道歉。
facts.anchor: He was freshly shaven and dressed impeccably in one of his signature suits

facts.fact: 湖边天鹅鸭子悠然游水、湖面辽阔、对岸耸立两座古塔，令她觉得像撞进一幅活的画。
facts.anchor: But the sight of the swans and the ducks swimming peacefully in the water, the sheer immensity of its size, the two old towers rising on a distant shore

facts.fact: 夜幕降临后她又在台阶上多站了片刻，才脱掉鞋子悄悄跟上 Alexander，怕鞋跟声暴露行踪。
facts.anchor: Night had fallen outside, and I stood a moment longer before following Alexander
